notes.title: 🎉 Fully Released!
notes.content:
It took a little longer than expected, but we made it! After more than two years of development and polish,
[h3][b]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/b] has officially fully launched![/h3]

Thank you so much for your support and patience! Whether you've been here since the beginning or just joined recently, this milestone wouldn't have happened without you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43965018/31bc05a8c948a911314958b915c492390642fce3.png[/img]

[h1]What's new:[/h1]

[h3]Out of Early Access[/h3]
The visual novel is complete with all its planned features and fully playable from the start to the bitter end! ːedgardoː With multiple endings.

[h3]Partial voice acting added[/h3]
All seven chapters now include some voice lines to better establish the characters.

[h3]Mac version now available[/h3]
The game now supports both Windows and macOS.

[h3]Artbook DLC released[/h3]
Take a behind-the-scenes look at sketches, concepts and early drafts in a beautifully compiled PDF! Grab the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699290/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial__Artbook/]artbook[/url] and support future creative projects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43965018/abb2b1e1af95620866f824f4813859f17f9f3fb5.jpg[/img]

I've poured a lot into this visual novel over the past years - writing, editing, coordinating, testing... It was the story I really wanted to tell, and I hope you'll enjoy the finished version.

[h3]If you haven't played in a while, now's the perfect time to jump back in and see how far the game has come.[/h3]

[h3]If you've enjoyed it, a short review or share on social media really helps spread the word![/h3]

Thank you again for supporting indie games and making releases like this possible!💜

- Lamb

notes.title: The Final Chapter is Here! 🎉
notes.content:
[h3]Hello, demonhearts and VN enjoyers![/h3]

[h2]The wait is over - the final chapter of [b]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/b] is now live![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43965018/d897fa3a30afc0aae6d0b50203ee0b9351674d2c.jpg[/img]

[*] Chapter 7 is now included in the game (as of version 1.36)

[*] The game now has 7 endings, other than the couple of "bad endings" it had in an earlier chapter
[*] A small feature added: A triangle button in the lower-right can hide the UI, in addition to middle clicking

The plan is to:
[*] Fix any potential issues with the content, logic, etc
[*] Implement partial voice acting
[*] Make a Mac OS version
[*] Create an artbook DLC

When all this is done, the game will transition out of early access into full release.

Thank you all for your support! I hope you will enjoy the finale!

notes.title: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial - Chapter 7 Progress
notes.content:
Hello, demonhearts and visual novel enjoyers!

[h1]I'm glad to say that we've been making good progress on the last chapter of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=rc-25-02-15]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url].[/h1]

A certain player choice will branch the story, the characters will say some different things as a consequence of previous choices, and there will be multiple endings. Because of this, the last chapter has a much higher word count, so there is more content to polish than in the previous chapters. We have yet to see how it will affect the actual play time.

I am currently editing the script, adding smaller player choices. The major ones are already implemented. While I shared some early screenshots before, my priority right now is to polish up the script before setting up all the visuals.

The aim is to add Chapter 7 to the game in the second half of March. It will remain in early access for a little while after that, to make sure there aren't any oversights. Also, after the last chapter is published, I will start looking for voice actors and directing them to implement partial voice acting.

I hope to be back soon with the last chapter! Thank you for your interest!

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/55c887000bd695a76290a52aee1670249aca7f45.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Notes v1.33
notes.content:
I've been polishing the existing content in various places.

One scene that got some new lines is a scene in Chapter 4 where the main character thinks about Vita in a nostalgic way. I realized this was another instance where your relationship points should be taken into account, so I've added some new conditional lines. Now hopefully, if you don't like Vita, the scene will sound more creepy and less nostalgic. And if you have some Evil points and low "Vita Approval", there will be a new line mentioning her "annoying face."

notes.title: Update Notes v1.32
notes.content:
In this update, I've edited and polished some lines in the existing chapters for better flow. The meaning has stayed the same.

The only exception is a line that used to say the city of Ravage "was already a ruin" by the time MC was born. This was supposed to refer to the sad state of Ravage as seen in Demonheart: Hunters, but it sounded misleading. It made some players wonder if Janiya is old enough to have visited Ravage before the MC was born, which was not the intention.

Stay tuned as we work on the final chapter, and thank you for your patience!

notes.title: Update v1.29
notes.content:
In this update, I've reduced the amount of Kaisar Approval needed for some options and consequences in Chapter 6.

Some of you have said that Kaisar didn't invite you to the tower even in your playthrough where you were nice to him. Now it will be easier for him to invite you. He is supposed to do it even if you betrayed him earlier, and this leads to some unique responses after the romance scene. But previously, it may have been difficult to reach that path since the betrayal itself lowers his approval.

There are many mini-branches and choices where you can gain points with him, and while I thought the approval conditions in this chapter were not too strict, I've had to reconsider them.

The requirements for unlocking a few dialog choices and his reactions have changed as well.

[h3]My latest project in the Demonheart world just got a major update![/h3]

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=rc_24_09_24]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url] Chapter 6 is out![/h2]

notes.title: Update v1.24

In this update, I edited a lot of lines in the existing chapters and added some more choices. Many lines have been rewritten for better flow or to better reflect the intended meaning without changing the story.

Here is a list of lines that changed meaning and new choices added:
[list]
[*] When you meet Vita, you can now clearly answer that you never "made the wrong people angry" without criticizing Vita.
[*] Added a choice to be extremely nice to Kaisar when you first meet him + a choice to tell him he should visit Raven Falls.
[*] Changed Elos's reaction to Janiya when they first meet. Instead of smiling deliriously, he questions if she is offering him water for free and appears more in thought.
[*] Fixed an error while exploring the crypt - Vita didn't always take a candle to test it, but it was being referred to later. She will now take a candle and spill wax in every choice.
[*] Rewrote and added some lines when Ran and Vita talk about the black bow in the watchtower.
[*] Changed what Leona says about Elos on Day 2 when you say that you should both watch out for him.
[*] Added a tactful option to ask Leona about Ran on Day 2. Leona clarifies that they are not together. Added another rude option to push her to say something similar, except she gets very angry.
[*] Rewrote some of Ran's lines to make it clearer that he's not attracted to Leona.
[*] Changed the wording of some of Bane's lines to make him sound more epic and less modern.
[/list]

notes.title: Update v1.16
notes.content:
This update changes some more text in Day/Chapter 3.

After reading a lot of player theories on discord (thank you for posting theories), I realized the dream scene with the Assassin was not clear enough, and it led to some confusion. Part of the confusion is of course intended ːlaughing_yetiː but there was also an unintentional effect of this scene appearing like a flashback, when it's mainly meant to be a nightmare. In this update, I've reworded some of the Assassin's lines to hopefully sound like they are talking to the main character in the present and not as a flashback. I've also edited the main character's thoughts so that she sounds more secure when she states she did not really speak to the Assassin.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43965018/f7204a222c03e8704d0788a127ad3bd0da7db6b6.png[/img]

notes.title: Update v1.15
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43965018/1da944573413c485795841132b995a6a87b5d89c.png[/img]

This update changes some of the text and content in Chapter 3.

[h3]If you haven't played Chapter 3, please ignore the rest of this text, as it will be confusing and might include spoilers.[/h3]

There has been more than one complaint about a certain part in Chapter 3 where the MC is thinking about Vita and the narration is leaning toward loving Vita. Some players played an MC who hates Vita, and got annoyed that the MC thinks she cares about her. Note, there were already different branches of narration written about it. It was dependent on Vita's approval points and your Good or Evil alignment. The problem arose if you were trying to roleplay a lying character and that's why you had a (fake) good relationship status with Vita. In this case, the game would assume you genuinely liked her. Many players do, and I thought it would be a bigger mistake to assume you don't. The game hardly has a way to know if you're lying or not.

In any case, this was an issue that bothered more than one player, so I decided to skip the mind-reading and let you pick an option. So now, please don't get annoyed if you get a really evil choice even if you love Vita... since it's also possible to hate her. Now it's a choice instead of invisible conditions that lead to a narration that assumes it knows what you think. The pro-Vita choice and the "Good" choice have conditions, so they will not always appear, but you don't need an extremely high amount of approval or Good points to see them. And the choice "forget Vita" will always appear.

Some things have stayed the way they were in order for the story to continue, but I hope Vita-simping has been reduced to an acceptable level.

I also added a few more choices around that part, Vita-related and Kaisar-related, and some more Good/Evil points.

notes.title: Progress Update - End of November 2023
notes.content:
Hello! I'm here with a progress update on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=23_12_01]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url], which came out in early access.

I'm happy with the reactions the game has received so far, as well as the love certain characters are getting. ːhappy_yetiː

There is now fanart of the Cursed Trial characters.  ːsurprised_yetiː Some of it is in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2364560/images/]Artwork[/url] section in the Steam community, and more art has been posted on the Rolling Crown Discord or Tumblr, Twitter etc, if you search for it.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/f1cd77c8c327470d262484aa7a923ef4ce2cdd87.png[/img]

I have been working on the script for the next chapter. As of today, around 12.400 words are in-game for Chapter 4, with more in text documents, waiting to be edited and used. After I am done with the first version of the text, the game will still need testing, scene edits for the scenes that turn out to need it, and polish such as adding sound effects. There will be two new CGs, which are already finished. The estimate for the chapter's release is early February.

I have posted the planned timeline for releasing all the chapters on the store page and in the Steam discussions [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2364560/discussions/0/4035850170399796343/]here[/url] - it could change over time, but that is the general plan. With the holiday season ahead, I expected late December and early January to be a slower time for work, so that's why Chapter 4 is planned to come out in February, even though it feels like it could be finished sooner. ːdazed_yetiː

notes.title: We have a Launch Date! - Demonheart: The Cursed Trial
notes.content:
After a lengthy consideration, we've decided to launch in Steam Early Access sooner rather than later.

So far, we've had some amazing feedback and player theories. Also, it feels really great to discuss the VN with players while I'm still writing it as opposed to working on the story alone in the dark for two years. ːedgardoː

The game currently contains three polished chapters out of the seven planned chapters. Voice acting is planned for the future, when all the text is finished. The word counts are 19.000 to 26.000 words per chapter - a little over 67.000 words so far. When it's fully finished, this will be Rolling Crown's longest VN yet. ːsurprised_yetiː

[h2]The launch is scheduled for November 13th![/h2]
[h3]Wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=rc_23_11_4]the game[/url] if you haven't already done so ːhappy_yetiː and thank you for following![/h3]

Changes:
[list]
[*] Rephrased many lines of narration and dialog.
[*] Changed some expressions and sprite positions. Changed Ran's expression on several occasions into less childish and more manly ones. ':)
[*] Added a few new choices and NPC lines - nothing crucial, but these changes will mess with old saves. Old alignment and relationship points will be preserved, but you may end up on the wrong line when you reload.
